name: uptime
title: Uptime
description: How a service has been, one tick to a day.
use: A status page or a service's row on a dashboard: the last thirty, sixty or ninety days at a glance. Each item says in words what its day was like; the stylesheet draws it as a tick and keeps the words for assistive technology. Good days are quiet, so the days that were not are what is seen.

instead.when: Each cell is a number on a scale, not a state
It is one reading now, not a history
The incidents themselves are listed with their times

classes.name: uptime
classes.description: The row, 32px tall: ticks that share its width, 2px apart

classes.name: uptime-sm
classes.description: A 16px row with ticks 1px apart, for a line of a table

classes.name: uptime-day
classes.description: One day, as a tick in a quiet tint of ink. Its text says what the day was like and is moved out of sight

classes.name: uptime-degraded
classes.description: A day the service was slow or partly failing, in the warning hue

classes.name: uptime-down
classes.description: A day the service was down, in the danger hue

classes.name: uptime-none
classes.description: A day with no data, in the tone of a hairline

properties.name: --uptime-color
properties.description: The ink a good day is tinted with

example:
1. 10 November: operational
  2. 11 November: degraded for 42 minutes
  3. 12 November: operational
